name: witness-for-ring
description: Witness for Ring: virtual sensors you teach, evidence you can trust, privacy you can see.

scripts.dev: npm run build:verify && concurrently -n server,web -c blue,magenta "npm run dev -w @witness/server" "npm run dev -w @witness/web"
scripts.build: npm run build -w witness-verify && npm run build -w @witness/server && npm run build -w @witness/web
scripts.test: npm run build:verify && npm test -w witness-verify && npm test -w @witness/server
scripts.typecheck: npm run build:verify && npm run typecheck -w @witness/server && npm run typecheck -w @witness/web
